'''Demelza Mintori''', leader of [[Demelza's Destructors]], lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Mintori was previously a member of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. While fighting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces in the [[Dalcretti system/Legends|Dalcretti system]], Mintori's [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] either was unable to, or refused to, aid a platoon under the command of [[Madrix Hansor]]. Since then, Hansor swore vengeance and the grudge carried over when they became captains of [[gladiator walker]] teams.

Mintori's team were based in [[Sedratis City]], and eventually Hansor led his Hooligans there and took control of the [[Sedratis Coliseum]] and challenged Mintori and the Destructors to evict them.
